public_rationale: The International Federation of Robotics reported on September 30, 2026 that almost 34.2 million consumer robots were sold in 2025 [e2]. That figure measures annual sales, not the worldwide deployed population, and the item does not establish reliability comparable to April 2024 driverless cars [e2]. It therefore establishes neither the reliability condition nor a qualifying billion-unit deployment, leaving the forecast unresolved [e2].
limitations: Consumer robot categories may differ from the personal robots intended by the claim.
Annual sales do not establish deployed stock after accounting for retirements and duplication.
No representative comparison establishes the specified outlier unreliability.
A finite period below one billion deployments cannot confirm an unlimited negative forecast.
